{{nihongo|'''Ibuki Shrine'''|伊富岐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Ibuki Shrine''' (いぶきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tarui, Gifu|arz|تاروى|ceb|Tarui-chō|es|Tarui (Gifu)|fa|تاروی، گیفو|fr|Tarui|gn|Tarúi (Gíhu)|hy|Տարուի|it|Tarui|ja|垂井町|ko|다루이정|mg|Tarui|ms|Tarui, Gifu|my|တရုအိမြို့၊ ဂိဖု|pl|Tarui|ru|Таруи|sv|Tarui|tl|Tarui, Gifu|tr|Tarui|uk|Таруй|ur|تروئی، گیفو|uz|Tarui (Gifu)|zh|垂井町|qid=Q1345531}}, {{ill|Fuwa District, Gifu|ca|Districte de Fuwa|ceb|Fuwa-gun|es|Distrito de Fuwa (Gifu)|eu|Fuwa barrutia|fa|شهرستان فووا، گیفو|fr|District de Fuwa|gn|Fúgua amunda|id|Distrik Fuwa, Gifu|it|Distretto di Fuwa|ja|不破郡|ko|후와군|pl|Powiat Fuwa|pt|Distrito de Fuwa|uk|Повіт Фува|vi|Fuwa, Gifu|zh|不破郡|qid=Q521316}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former rank in the {{ill|Q712534|lt=Modern shrine ranking system}} was {{ill|Ken-sha|qid=Q90139226|lt=kensha}}. It is regarded as the {{ill|Ichinomiya|Q1656379|qid=Q1656379|lt=second shrine}} of {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}.

The shrine buildings face east-southeast and are laid out with {{ill|Mount Ibuki|arz|جبل مونت ايبوكى|ceb|Ibuki-yama|es|Monte Ibuki|fa|کوه ایبوکی|fr|Mont Ibuki|id|Gunung Ibuki|ja|伊吹山|ko|이부키산|lld|Mont Ibuki|my|အိဘုခိတောင်|pl|Ibuki (góra)|pnb|ٹلہ ایبوکی|ru|Ибуки (гора)|tr|Ibuki Dağı|uk|Ібукі (гора)|vi|Núi Ibuki|zh|伊吹山|qid=Q2624360}} behind them.

===Enshrined deity===
The enshrined deity of Ibuki Shrine is not clearly established. There are several theories, including that it enshrines the ancestral deity of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ifuku clan}}, which held power in this region in ancient times:
*Tatamihiko-no-Mikoto (also called Ebifuku-dake-no-kami, Ibuki-o-no-kami, and Ibuki-no-kami; deity of {{ill|Mount Ibuki|arz|جبل مونت ايبوكى|ceb|Ibuki-yama|es|Monte Ibuki|fa|کوه ایبوکی|fr|Mont Ibuki|id|Gunung Ibuki|ja|伊吹山|ko|이부키산|lld|Mont Ibuki|my|အိဘုခိတောင်|pl|Ibuki (góra)|pnb|ٹلہ ایبوکی|ru|Ибуки (гора)|tr|Ibuki Dağı|uk|Ібукі (гора)|vi|Núi Ibuki|zh|伊吹山|qid=Q2624360}})
*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yamata no Orochi}}
*{{ill|Amenohoakari|Q10940411|qid=Q10940411}}
*{{ill|Ugayafukiaezu|Q1373935|qid=Q1373935|lt=Kusa-ashi-fuai-no-Mikoto}}
etc.

===Location===
*Iwate Aza Ibuki 1484-1, Tarui, Fuwa District, Gifu Prefecture
**Nearest stations are {{ill|Tarui Station (Gifu)|eo|Stacio Tarui (Gifu)|id|Stasiun Tarui (Gifu)|it|Stazione di Tarui (Gifu)|ja|垂井駅|ko|다루이역 (기후현)|ur|تاروئی اسٹیشن (گیفو)|zh|垂井車站|qid=Q771019}} on the {{ill|Tōkaidō Main Line|Q1190152|qid=Q1190152}} or {{ill|Sekigahara Station|eo|Stacio Sekigahara|id|Stasiun Sekigahara|it|Stazione di Sekigahara|ja|関ケ原駅|ko|세키가하라역|ur|سیکی گاہارا اسٹیشن|zh|關原車站|qid=Q872034}}, both about 3.5 km away.
**Nearest bus stop was "Ibuki-guchi" on the {{ill|Meihan Kintetsu Bus|ja|名阪近鉄バス|qid=Q11415818}} Ōgaki-Sekigahara line, about 1.5 km away (route abolished in 2009).

=== Other ===
[[Image:Ibuki-Jinjya-Tarui06.JPG|thumb|100px|Great cedar standing on the left side of the haiden]]
*The {{ill|Cryptomeria|Q147388|qid=Q147388}} in the precincts, called the "Great Cedar of Ibuki Shrine," is a Gifu Prefecture designated natural monument. It is about 30 m tall, about 9.6 m around the roots, and estimated to be over 300 years old<ref>{{Cite web|和書|author= |date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku-bunka-sports/bunka-geijutsu/bunkazai-zuroku/bunkazai-zuroku/tenki/taruichou/ibuki.html |title=Great cedar of Ibuki Shrine |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2012-10-16}}
</ref>.
*The {{ill|Kagura|Q1348260|qid=Q1348260}} of Ibuki Shrine began in {{ill|1787|Q7763|qid=Q7763}} ({{ill|Tenmei|Q1194121|qid=Q1194121}} 7) as a prayer for a good harvest, and is offered annually on the second Sunday of April.
